reviews.title: Charge me for prescription even when I canceled the trial before renewal date
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and used the trial premium version to create some picture collage, it didn’t turn out the way I like so I immediately cancel the trial and no longer have the app on my phone. Then after a week, I got charged for the subscription. I submitted a refund request and it was denied although I have valid reason. Please don’t offer the free trial and still charge people even when they cancel BEFORE renewal date. Now I lost money and not even use your service.

reviews.text: I used to use this app to make collages for instagram years ago. Ive returned to it today to do the same thing however to my dismay almost every single collage option is premium only. Who on gods green earth is wasting their hard earned money on premium for an app that gives you formats.  Whoever decided to change it and make everything premium i hope you have a long hard think about your relationship with money and acknowledge the fact you are a money hungry evil human being. I simply cannot believe how much the app has changed and I’m so incredibly disappointed in you for who you have become mr/miss collage app person. I sincerely hope my disgust is portrayed clearly in this message and it allows you to really evaluate your life choices and who you have become.

reviews.title: Why suddenly need access to ALL photos???
reviews.text:
Have had this app for many years. Just tried to open and it said the app only works if it has access to all photos, not just the ones I selected. What. This is the creepiest and most suspicious this ever. Even worse than this app hiding secret folders in files. Check folders. Ridiculous. These are scammers

Update: they responded and said it is required under new ios updates. It's not. Not at all, not even close. And in fact, there is still an option to only allow access to selected photos - the app just won't launch now if you have that checked. It has to be all. There are already a lot of very questionable ads in the app so they already had a monetization angle. 

Have they considered the risk to themselves of harvesting photos they were not explicitly given access to? They are definitely using them for unauthorized purposes and there is a high likelihood their servers are holding illegal material.
